title: A key left with reception
passage:
Didn’t Leo say he’d leave the service key with reception?
A. The reception desk is being moved upstairs.
B. He did, but they’ve already given it to me.
C. It fits the side door as well.
passageZh:
里奧不是說他會把維修用鑰匙留在接待處嗎？
A. 接待處的櫃台正在搬到樓上。
B. 他有這麼說，不過接待處已經把鑰匙交給我了。
C. 側門也能用這把鑰匙。
